This version reads both documents directly from EDGAR: the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000320193-24-000123) and the 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001308179-25-000008, filed January 10, 2025). Cash and stock-comp values match the SEC XBRL facts. LEADER: Steve Jobs is deceased. The 2025 proxy's ownership table lists only Vanguard, BlackRock, the directors and the named executive officers; the words 'Jobs' and 'Powell' do not appear anywhere in the proxy, so no Jobs estate, family or trust holding is disclosed and family is null. The 10-K and proxy contain no statement about Jobs, so the leader has no source. HOLDERS: Vanguard and BlackRock percentages are stale; the proxy bases them on Schedule 13G/A filings reporting ownership at the end of December 2023, applied against the January 2, 2025 share count. Dividends include dividend equivalents paid on RSUs, as the cash-flow line says. The segment note (Note 13) shows the same five segment figures.
